name: UI Layer
description: SwiftUI screens, tab shell, glass theme, and FuelTrackApp entry that present fuel, spend, trips, and vehicle workflows.

name: Service Layer
description: Domain logic for fuel stats, trip recording, Fuelio/backup import-export, DVLA compliance, location, and nearby station lookups.

name: Data Layer
description: SwiftData models and domain enums for vehicles, fill-ups, trips, costs, personal expenses, stations, and reminders.

name: App Support
description: Cross-cutting helpers that track the active vehicle and provide Identifiable wrappers for SwiftUI lists.

name: Scripts & Smoke Tests
description: Standalone Swift smoke scripts and Fuelio CSV fixtures that validate import, backup round-trips, and stats math outside the app target.

name: Documentation
description: Project README, Trip Logger design/plan docs, and the Fuelio feature-parity checklist.

name: Configuration
description: SPM manifest, xtool deploy settings, Info.plist, git attributes, and Understand-Anything analyzer config.
